_comment: Literals that must reach the page exactly as the source wrote them, in every
target language. Add a name here; no code changes.
This is not the glossary. The glossary is per-language and settles what a term
must become; this settles that a string becomes nothing at all. It is lifted
out before the engine sees it and restored verbatim afterwards, the same
machinery that protects 3/4, so it does not depend on the model obeying a
Keep entries in their exact published capitalisation: matching is
case-sensitive so the brand 'Curriculum Associates' is protected while the
common noun 'curriculum' in the prose is not. Longer entries win over shorter
ones that prefix them, so listing both a full legal name and its short form is
